places-cova-remigia-abric-iii-valmayor-v.story: A 165 km round trip from Ares del Maestre - roughly 2 h 51 in the saddle. On the way it passes La Saltadora- Abric I, Abric del mas dels Ous, Valmayor V and back through Abric del mas dels Ous. The highest point is about 1,100 m.
